text:
toni: Quick kickoff: CloudMart + Redwood are running a co-branded livestream ("Marketplace Launch Live") on 2024-09-12 09:00-12:00 PT. Primary asks: final run-of-show, demo reliability plan + remote access for attendees, co-branded marketplace listing timing, and swag fulfillment (physical + digital). Who owns what?

lee: I can own run-of-show + speaker ops. Need speaker slides by 2024-08-30 and 2x 30-min rehearsal slots (one timezone-friendly). Will make a shared calendar invite. :white_check_mark:

arjun: I’ll take demo infra. Requirements: container images (OCI), public demo endpoints or SSH bastion access, sample dataset (1GB), and a health-check endpoint. Prefer ephemeral staging hosts and a pre-recorded fallback. Who can provide SSH key(s)?

pat: Swag here. Options: physical kit (sticker pack + tee + dongle) or digital (partner credits + e-gift). For international attendees we should default to digital unless they opt into shipping. Need addresses CSV by 2024-09-05. Also need HS codes for customs if shipping to EU/UK.

partnersvc: CloudMart confirms: we can publish the marketplace listing on the day after the event (2024-09-13) at 08:00 PT. For embargoed press, we require final product blurb (max 400 words), three marketing images (1200x628, 800x800, 400x400), and the landing link by 2024-08-28. Also: we can provide 2 co-branded coupon codes for marketplace trials.

opsbot: staging-cluster:redeploy: success
```
service: demo-gateway
image: registry.redwood/infer-demo:latest
ports: 8080->80, 8443->443
health: /_hc (200)
```
opsbot: Note: rate limit 10 rps set on demo-gateway by default.

toni: Backup plan: if live demo fails, we switch to pre-recorded video + live Q&A. Need each demo owner to record a 5-8 minute fallback video and upload to shared drive by 2024-09-08.

arjun: For hardware partner VectorWorks: they can lend 5 demo rigs. They need a signed MOU and a contact for customs. VectorWorks asked for a test window to validate network egress on 2024-09-03. Recommend ngrok/ssh bastion for remote access — I'll set one up and post creds (ephemeral).

lee: Speaker rehearsal plan: two sessions (2024-09-05 16:00 PT, 2024-09-10 09:00 PT). Each speaker gets 10 minutes + 5 minutes Q&A in the run-through. Please RSVP.

pat: Swag logistics detail: 
- Physical: ship in batches (speakers/demos first).
- Digital: issue 1-time promo codes tied to emails (we can limit to one redemption).
We should include a small card with quickstart instructions + support contact.

partnersvc: Also confirm PR window: embargo lifts 2024-09-13 00:00 PT. Please mark any partner quotes you want cleared by legal by 2024-08-26.

toni: Action items summary:
- lee: run-of-show + invites + collect slides (due 2024-08-30)
- arjun: demo staging + ngrok bastion + fallback videos (test 2024-09-03, videos due 2024-09-08)
- pat: swag CSV + HS codes + shipping plan (addresses due 2024-09-05)
- partnersvc: marketplace assets + coupon codes + embargo confirmation (assets due 2024-08-28)
- all: flag legal quotes by 2024-08-26

lee: Ill post calendar invites shortly and a sheet for slide uploads. Any objections to the rehearsal times?

arjun: No objections. Ill post the bastion instructions to the sheet and tag demo owners. Will need the list of demo owners' emails.

pat: Creating a Google form for address collection; will share link tomorrow. Adding an opt-out for international physical shipping.

partnersvc: Well share co-brand guidelines and logo files by EOD Thu. Also we can host an interim marketing sync next week if helpful.

toni: Great. Next sync: 2024-08-29 10:00 PT to confirm slides, assets, and swag CSV. Thanks team! :rocket:
